_comment: IPIP-VIA (International Personality Item Pool, HEXACO-derived public-domain correlates of the VIA Inventory of Strengths/Character Strengths, http://ipip.ori.org/newVIAKey.htm, fetched 2026-10-19). Registered as part of a batch onboarding driven by 12.gdx.virtology/GoDataX_H7ph_33_Virtudes_Instrumentos_Psicometricos.xlsx, which suggests VIA / IPIP-VIA as the instrument for most of the 33 virtues. The VIA Inventory of Strengths itself is NOT public domain (registration/license required at viacharacter.org per the spreadsheet's own 'Instrumentos e Fontes' sheet); IPIP's own 'VIA Key' page hosts a genuinely public-domain, freely reproducible alternative measure correlated with each VIA strength (HEXACO-based items), used here instead so no proprietary item text is reproduced. 15 of the ~24 VIA strengths are bundled here -- exactly the ones the spreadsheet's virtue-by-virtue mapping actually needs; Judgment/Open-mindedness and Curiosity were available on the same IPIP page but are not used (Flexibilidade uses the more literal HEXACO 'Flexibility' facet instead -- see the sibling instrument 'IPIP - HEXACO-PI/NEO-PI-R Facet Scales'). Catalog registration only -- no participant data collected or associated with this record.

study.title: IPIP-VIA Character Strengths Scales - Instrument Onboarding
study.objective: Register the IPIP-VIA (HEXACO-derived, public-domain) character-strengths scales used as the Virtology virtue-association batch's primary source for most of the 33 virtues, per GoDataX_H7ph_33_Virtudes_Instrumentos_Psicometricos.xlsx.
study.method: Desk research of the public-domain International Personality Item Pool (ipip.ori.org/newVIAKey.htm); catalog registration only, no primary data collection associated with this record.

instruments.name: IPIP-VIA (HEXACO-derived) Character Strengths Scales
instruments.description: Goldberg, L. R., et al. International Personality Item Pool (http://ipip.ori.org), 'VIA Key' page -- public-domain, HEXACO-derived alternative items correlated with the VIA Inventory of Strengths' character strengths (Peterson & Seligman, 2004), developed for use in place of the proprietary, registration-gated VIA-IS. Bundles the 15 strengths needed to cover the Virtology virtues whose suggested instrument in GoDataX_H7ph_33_Virtudes_Instrumentos_Psicometricos.xlsx is VIA/IPIP-VIA.
instruments.instructions: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of the same sex as you are, and roughly your same age. Read each statement and select the response that most accurately describes you.
instruments.phenomenon_description: The positive personality traits catalogued by the VIA Classification of Character Strengths and Virtues, measured here through IPIP's public-domain HEXACO-derived correlate items rather than the proprietary VIA-IS.

constructs.name: Appreciation of Beauty and Excellence (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Noticing and appreciating beauty, excellence, and/or skilled performance in various domains of life, from nature to the arts to everyday experience.

constructs.name: Capacity to Love and Be Loved (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Valuing close relations with others, in particular those in which sharing and caring are reciprocated.

constructs.name: Citizenship/Teamwork (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Working well as a member of a group or team; being loyal to the group; doing one's share.

constructs.name: Equity/Fairness (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Treating all people fairly and justly; not letting personal feelings bias decisions about others; giving everyone a fair chance.

constructs.name: Forgiveness (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Forgiving those who have done wrong; accepting others' shortcomings; giving people a second chance; not being vengeful.

constructs.name: Hope/Optimism (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Expecting the best in the future and working to achieve it; believing that a good future is something that can be brought about.

constructs.name: Humor/Playfulness (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Liking to laugh and tease; bringing smiles to other people; seeing the light side of life.

constructs.name: Industry/Perseverance/Persistence (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Finishing what one starts; persisting in a course of action despite obstacles; taking pleasure in completing tasks.

constructs.name: Integrity/Honesty/Authenticity (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Speaking the truth and presenting oneself in a genuine way; being without pretense; taking responsibility for one's feelings and actions.

constructs.name: Kindness/Generosity (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Doing favors and good deeds for others; helping them; taking care of them.

constructs.name: Leadership (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Encouraging a group to get things done while maintaining good relations within the group; organizing group activities and seeing that they happen.

constructs.name: Love of Learning (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Mastering new skills, topics, and bodies of knowledge, whether on one's own or formally; being systematically adding to what one knows.

constructs.name: Modesty/Humility (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Letting one's accomplishments speak for themselves; not regarding oneself as more special than one is.

constructs.name: Self-Regulation/Self-Control (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Regulating what one feels and does; being disciplined; controlling one's appetites and emotions.

constructs.name: Spirituality/Religiousness (IPIP-VIA)
constructs.definition: Having coherent beliefs about the higher purpose and meaning of the universe, and knowing where one fits within it.
